runtime_binding_caveat: An import graph is a hypothesis about coupling read from use declarations. It does not represent runtime binding: dynamic dispatch, dependency injection, plugin registration, configuration-driven selection and reflection all couple code that no import names. The execution surface measured at R2.5 lists those mechanisms separately, and a proposition touching one of them may not be classified observed on this graph alone. This run enumerated no dynamic mechanism at R2.5, which is a fact about this subject and not a promise that none is there.
